adaptorPublicKey.description: Optional adaptor point T (hex-encoded 33-byte compressed secp256k1 pubkey). When set, Turnkey produces a Schnorr adaptor pre-signature with the FROST challenge bound to `R+T` (where `R` is the aggregate group nonce commitment from FROST). The party holding the discrete log `t` completes the pre-sig to a valid BIP-340 signature by adding `t` (or `-t`, for parity) to the signature scalar `s`. This is primarily used by Spark leaves-swap and other adaptor-bound flows; absent or empty leads to plain FROST signing (the typical case).
